name: AmericasNLP 2021 Shared Task: Translation for Indigenous Americas Languages
description: AmericasNLP 2021 Shared Task dataset provides parallel corpora for machine translation between Spanish and 10 indigenous languages of the Americas: Ashaninka, Aymara, Bribri, Guarani, Hnahnu (Otomi), Nahuatl, Quechua, Raramuri (Tarahumara), Shipibo-Konibo, and Wixarika (Huichol). The benchmark provides clean training, development, and evaluation splits to advance natural language processing on extremely low-resource, endangered languages native to North, Central, and South America.

license.name: Multiple / Unspecified Source Terms
license.notes: The shared task compiles parallel corpora from multiple independent source projects (Axolotl, Tsunkua, JW300, OPUS GlobalVoices, and original publications). No unified license file exists in the repository; individual source corpora carry distinct or unspecified terms. Commercial permissions cannot be verified without independent clearance for each source subcorpus.

verification.notes: Verified 10 indigenous languages paired with Spanish, 88,511 parallel sentences across source corpora, and documented lack of unified repository license (heterogeneous/unspecified source terms with unknown commercial permission).

citation.paper_title: Findings of the AmericasNLP 2021 Shared Task on Open Machine Translation for Indigenous Languages of the Americas
